{
  "schema_version": "gametestlab.game-manifest.v3",
  "entry_path": "index.html",
  "surface": "canvas2d",
  "viewport": { "width": 800, "height": 600 },
  "controls": [
    {
      "action_id": "START",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#start-btn",
      "description": "开始游戏"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "RED",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#signal-canvas",
      "x_ratio": 0.25,
      "y_ratio": 0.25,
      "description": "点击红色区域"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "GREEN",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#signal-canvas",
      "x_ratio": 0.75,
      "y_ratio": 0.25,
      "description": "点击绿色区域"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "BLUE",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#signal-canvas",
      "x_ratio": 0.25,
      "y_ratio": 0.75,
      "description": "点击蓝色区域"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "YELLOW",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#signal-canvas",
      "x_ratio": 0.75,
      "y_ratio": 0.75,
      "description": "点击黄色区域"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "RESTART",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "mouse",
      "key_event": "press",
      "selector": "#restart-btn",
      "description": "重新开始并回到菜单"
    },
    {
      "action_id": "RESTART_KEY",
      "actor": "primary",
      "device": "keyboard",
      "key_event": "press",
      "code": "KeyR",
      "description": "键盘 R 回到菜单"
    }
  ],
  "hud_selectors": {
    "score": "[data-testid=\"score\"]",
    "status": "[data-testid=\"status\"]"
  },
  "state_schema": {
    "fields": {
      "status": { "type": "string", "description": "当前状态：menu/playing/won/lost" },
      "phase": { "type": "string", "description": "当前阶段：menu/playback/input" },
      "round": { "type": "integer", "description": "当前回合 1-3" },
      "lives": { "type": "integer", "description": "剩余生命 0-3" },
      "score": { "type": "integer", "description": "当前分数" },
      "progress": { "type": "integer", "description": "本回合已正确输入的颜色数" },
      "sequence": { "type": "array", "description": "当前回合的颜色序列，元素为 RED/GREEN/BLUE/YELLOW" },
      "last_feedback": { "type": "string", "description": "最近一次反馈文案" }
    },
    "required": ["status", "phase", "round", "lives", "score", "progress", "sequence", "last_feedback"]
  },
  "event_schema": [
    { "type": "game_started", "description": "游戏开始", "payload_fields": {} },
    { "type": "playback_started", "description": "序列播放开始", "payload_fields": {} },
    { "type": "input_phase_started", "description": "输入阶段开始", "payload_fields": {} },
    { "type": "input_ignored", "description": "播放阶段输入被忽略", "payload_fields": {} },
    { "type": "signal_correct", "description": "输入正确", "payload_fields": { "color": { "type": "string", "description": "正确的颜色" } } },
    { "type": "signal_wrong", "description": "输入错误", "payload_fields": { "color": { "type": "string", "description": "点击的颜色" }, "expected": { "type": "string", "description": "期望的颜色" } } },
    { "type": "round_completed", "description": "回合完成", "payload_fields": { "round": { "type": "integer", "description": "完成的回合" } } },
    { "type": "game_won", "description": "游戏胜利", "payload_fields": { "score": { "type": "integer", "description": "最终分数" } } },
    { "type": "game_lost", "description": "游戏失败", "payload_fields": {} },
    { "type": "game_reset", "description": "重置为菜单状态", "payload_fields": {} }
  ],
  "bridge": {
    "protocol": "gametestlab/2",
    "evidence_only": true,
    "actions_via_real_input": true
  }
}
